title: Systems-Level Decoding of Redox Homeostasis in Cancer: From ROS Biology to Therapeutic Vulnerabilities.
snippet: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) generated during cellular respiration are highly reactive toward proteins, lipids, and DNA. title: The Interplay Between Oophorectomy and Alzheimer's Disease: A Narrative Review.
snippet: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is the leading cause of dementia worldwide and affects women more frequently than men.
